about_the_game:
Uncover the mysteries of a lost civilization in this creature-collecting adventure. Inscribe your findings into a bestiary—a tome with the forgotten lore of Yselion and its creatures. With every entry, you draw closer to the truth behind the fallen empire and the Beasts that roam its ruins. Hatch, train, and forge deep bonds with unique Beasts as you face the legendary Star Trials—only the fittest will endure.



Raise over 100 Fully Animated Beasts, train them and as you guide their evolution into powerful paragons.

Each Beast follows a unique path, shaped by your choices and raising. Will your companion become a ruthless Tyrant, a noble Monarch, or a cunning Archon? Every Adult Beast can be ridden!

Venture into an untamed, open world teeming with secrets and lurking dangers. Chart your own path riding your Beasts through perilous landscapes, but beware—one wrong step could bring you face to face with something far more dangerous than you ever imagined.

Beasts are more than just companions—they are part of an eternal cycle. As they pass away, the power they've acquired lives on, stored within mysterious orbs that can be absorbed by other Beasts. Through this endless flow of hearts and souls, the next generation grows ever stronger. Death is not the end—it is only the next step in their journey.

Add Astra Bestiary to your wishlist and follow so you don't miss any updates!

short_description: Explore the savage wilderness in this creature-collecting RPG. Hatch, raise, and face unique Beasts in turn-based battles as you delve into ancient dungeons, overcoming obstacles and trials. Complete the Bestiary and learn the skills of Beastmastery to raise the ultimate team!
